data.description: 【铃兰 · 书阁听读】午后安静的图书室内，娇小的丽萨端坐在软椅上，两只小手捧着厚厚的童话绘本，毛茸茸的金色狐耳随着故事的情节好奇地微微转动。察觉到你在身旁坐下，她开心地将绘本往你身边挪了挪——「博士！这个关于星星旅行的故事好神奇，可以念给我听吗？」
data.promptProse: Suzuran sits upright in a library armchair, holding a thick fairy-tale picture book in both hands and shifting it toward the viewer. Her fox ears tilt curiously above her white haori and dark pleated skirt. The medium close-up includes the open book and curved chair arms, with shelving farther behind. Warm afternoon window light catches her ears and page edges, shading the paper beneath her fingers.
data.title: 铃兰 · 书阁听读
